title: Cascading AI Provider Quota Saturation and Queue Overflow

causal_chain.signal_observed: Document upload burst (+180 documents/min from batch client)
Queue backlog depth surged from 120 -> 2450 messages in 3 minutes
Worker CPU utilization spiked to 88% and memory RSS grew at +0.3%/min
Gemini API rate limit (429) hit; inference latency drifted to 3100ms
Task timeout exception raised; automatic retry queue triggered

root_cause_identified: Upstream unthrottled document upload burst exceeded Gemini RPM quota ceiling, causing AI inference latency spikes that cascaded into worker thread pool saturation and Redis queue backlog accumulation.

details.graph_algorithm: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Temporal Causal Inference
